entries.title: Job 30:1
segments: But now they that are younger than I have me in derision, Whose fathers I disdained to set with the dogs of my flock.

entries.title: Job 30:2
segments: Yea, the strength of their hands, whereto should it profit me? Men in whom ripe age is perished.

entries.title: Job 30:3
segments: They are gaunt with want and famine; They gnaw the dry ground, in the gloom of wasteness and desolation.

entries.title: Job 30:4
segments: They pluck salt-wort by the bushes;  And the roots of the broom are their food.

entries.title: Job 30:5
segments: They are driven forth from the midst [of men]; They cry after them as after a thief;

entries.title: Job 30:6
segments: So that they dwell in frightful valleys, In holes of the earth and of the rocks.

entries.title: Job 30:7
segments: Among the bushes they bray; Under the nettles they are gathered together.

entries.title: Job 30:8
segments: [They are] children of fools, yea, children of base men; They were scourged out of the land.

entries.title: Job 30:9
segments: And now I am become their song, Yea, I am a byword unto them.

entries.title: Job 30:10
segments: They abhor me, they stand aloof from me, And spare not to spit in my face.

entries.title: Job 30:11
segments: For he hath loosed his cord, and afflicted me; And they have cast off the bridle before me.

entries.title: Job 30:12
segments: Upon my right hand rise the rabble; They thrust aside my feet, And they cast up against me their ways of destruction.

entries.title: Job 30:13
segments: They mar my path, They set forward my calamity, [Even] men that have no helper.

entries.title: Job 30:14
segments: As through a wide breach they come: In the midst of the ruin they roll themselves [upon me].

entries.title: Job 30:15
segments: Terrors are turned upon me; They chase mine honor as the wind; And my welfare is passed away as a cloud.

entries.title: Job 30:16
segments: And now my soul is poured out within me; Days of affliction have taken hold upon me.

entries.title: Job 30:17
segments: In the night season my bones are pierced in me, And the [pains] that gnaw me take no rest.

entries.title: Job 30:18
segments: By [God's] great force is my garment disfigured; It bindeth me about as the collar of my coat.

entries.title: Job 30:19
segments: He hath cast me into the mire, And I am become like dust and ashes.

entries.title: Job 30:20
segments: I cry unto thee, and thou dost not answer me: I stand up, and thou gazest at me.

entries.title: Job 30:21
segments: Thou art turned to be cruel to me; With the might of thy hand thou persecutest me.

entries.title: Job 30:22
segments: Thou liftest me up to the wind, thou causest me to ride [upon it];  And thou dissolvest me in the storm.

entries.title: Job 30:23
segments: For I know that thou wilt bring me to death, And to the house appointed for all living.

entries.title: Job 30:24
segments: Howbeit doth not one stretch out the hand in his fall? Or in his calamity therefore cry for help?

entries.title: Job 30:25
segments: Did not I weep for him that was in trouble? Was not my soul grieved for the needy?

entries.title: Job 30:26
segments: When I looked for good, then evil came; And when I waited for light, there came darkness.

entries.title: Job 30:27
segments: My heart is troubled, and resteth not;  Days of affliction are come upon me.

entries.title: Job 30:28
segments: I go mourning without the sun: I stand up in the assembly, and cry for help.

entries.title: Job 30:29
segments: I am a brother to jackals, And a companion to ostriches.

entries.title: Job 30:30
segments: My skin is black, [and falleth] from me, And my bones are burned with heat.

entries.title: Job 30:31
segments: Therefore is my harp [turned] to mourning, And my pipe into the voice of them that weep.
